qa_pairs.instruction: What topics are covered in Part IV of the Platform Services Administration documentation for the Fan-Out driver?
qa_pairs.output: Part IV of the Platform Services Administration documentation for the Fan-Out driver provides information needed to plan, configure, administer, and troubleshoot the Linux and UNIX Platform Services of the NetIQ Identity Manager Fan-Out driver. It includes three chapters: Section 11.0 (Installing Platform Services), Section 12.0 (Configuring and Administering Platform Services), and Section 13.0 (Troubleshooting Platform Services).

qa_pairs.instruction: Why does the Fan-Out driver have a dedicated IV Platform Services Administration section?
qa_pairs.output: The Fan-Out driver includes a dedicated IV Platform Services Administration section because administrators need specific guidance for deploying, configuring, managing, and troubleshooting the Linux and UNIX Platform Services that support the NetIQ Identity Manager Fan-Out driver. This section consolidates all relevant procedures and troubleshooting information in one place.
